prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished concept art sheet for a teleportation DEVICE for RuneNexus, a stylized 3D tower defense game. Chapter 2 visual language: weathered grey-violet angular masonry, blue-grey slate floor tiles, faceted rock edges, restrained cyan and violet rune energy, hand-crafted stone material with readable bevels, not sci-fi machinery. This is a proposed in-map paired transfer device, distinct from the game's round purple spiral enemy-spawn portal. Show exactly TWO matching devices as an entrance/exit pair, left and right at equal scale on two small separated square path-tile samples, same design mirrored or orientation reversed; small engraved inward chevrons at entrance and outward chevrons at exit subtly communicate travel. No enemies, characters, turrets, big scenery or extra props. Dark neutral navy studio background, soft directional lighting, restrained bloom. Both devices fully visible from an elevated game-like three-quarter orthographic view, legible at small game size. Wide landscape sheet. Clear silhouette and visible usable passage. Stone must dominate; magic must not obscure construction. One short top-left label only, exact label specified below. No other text or watermark. Concept image only, not an in-game screenshot.  Text: "A · RUNE PAD". Subject: A low ground-level transfer pad: square chamfered stone frame set almost flush into the path, inset octagonal rune plate, four small corner keystones, a shallow luminous seam outlining a dark central transfer surface. No tall pillars, no arch, no upright ring, no giant energy beam. Distinct low profile; enemy can walk across it.
